parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's Ecker2015 parameter set, for one electrode pair of a Kokam SLPB 75106100 cell (Ecker et al. 2015). Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/2.0551509jes as implemented in PyBaMM's Ecker2015 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
The file describes one electrode pair (0.156 Ah) of the 7.5 Ah cell. Its positive electrode is NCO, which has no BattINFO material kind yet.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.14 mV RMS and 0.016% capacity (DFN discharges at 0.2C, 1C, 2C and 1C 20 K warmer).
